title: "Like that film"
phrase: dramatic like the Godfather dinner scene

commands.plan: python3 scripts/shotspeak.py plan --phrase "dramatic like the Godfather dinner scene" --subject "an old man at the head of a long table" --action "listening without a word" --setting "a dark dining room" --out examples/named-look

bad.prompt: dramatic dinner scene like The Godfather, cinematic, moody, dramatic lighting, 4k
bad.what_you_get: Many tools refuse the title. The others give a generic dark room with a man in the centre.

plain.prompt: An old man sits at the head of a long table in a dark dining room. He listens to the others and says nothing.
plain.what_you_get: A man at a table, lit evenly from the front. You see his eyes, so there is no secret.

skill.plain_words: The whole camera moves toward the subject. The background slides and grows too.
skill.feel: The viewer leans in. A decision or a realisation is happening.
look_makes: The light comes from straight above. The eyes sink into shadow, so the viewer cannot read the person.
The colour is warm amber and the picture is dark. Most of the room is black.
The camera is still, or it moves forward very slowly. Power sits and waits.
skill.what_you_get: The light comes from straight above, so his eyes are in shadow. The room is black and amber. The camera creeps toward him.

decisions.Camera movement: a steady push-in: the camera itself travels toward the subject for the whole shot, from a medium view to a chest-up view
decisions.Camera placement: at the subject's eye height, from the side at a three-quarter angle, starting 3 m away

skill.prompt_block:
SHOT: Push-in (dolly in). 16:9 frame, 3 to 5 s.
SUBJECT AND ACTION: an old man at the head of a long table listening without a word, in a dark dining room.
CAMERA MOVE: a steady push-in: the camera itself travels toward the subject for the whole shot, from a medium view to a chest-up view.
CAMERA PLACEMENT: at the subject's eye height, from the side at a three-quarter angle, starting 3 m away.
LENS: 50 mm.
LIGHT: one hard overhead source that makes a pool of light on the floor; the eyes fall into shadow under the brow; everything outside the pool is near black.
COLOUR: photochemical film look: fine grain, deep true blacks with detail, natural skin and material colours, restrained saturation.
SPEED: real time for the whole shot, fast and crisp, no slow motion.
LOOK: the light comes from straight above, so the eyes sink into shadow; warm amber tones, underexposed, most of the room black; the camera at eye height, almost still.
RULES: State the exact number of people. Screen direction stays the same for the whole shot.
AVOID: not a centred front-facing subject; the subject is off-centre, seen in profile, three-quarter or from behind; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; worn real textures with dust, creases and small defects, nothing plastic or perfectly clean.
skill.one_line: An old man at the head of a long table listening without a word; the camera itself travels steadily toward them from a three-quarter side position at eye height, from a medium view to chest-up, the background sliding past; 50 mm lens; one hard overhead source that makes a pool of light on the floor; the eyes fall into shadow under the brow; everything outside the pool is near black; photochemical film look: fine grain, deep true blacks with detail, natural skin and material colours, restrained saturation; real time for the whole shot, fast and crisp, no slow motion; the light comes from straight above, so the eyes sink into shadow; warm amber tones, underexposed, most of the room black; the camera at eye height, almost still. Avoid: not a centred front-facing subject; the subject is off-centre, seen in profile, three-quarter or from behind; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; real time, with slow motion only where the shot states it.
skill.image_prompt:
A single still frame from a live-action film, 16:9 frame. A storyboard-grade production mock that shows framing, lens, light and colour.
SUBJECT: an old man at the head of a long table listening without a word, in a dark dining room. Generic stand-in figures, not a likeness of any real person.
CAMERA: a chest-up frame from a three-quarter side position at the subject's eye height, with a soft foreground edge on one side of the frame that shows the camera is moving in. Camera placement: at the subject's eye height, from the side at a three-quarter angle, starting 3 m away.
LENS: 50 mm; normal lens look: neutral perspective, close to how the eye sees.
LIGHT: one hard overhead source that makes a pool of light on the floor; the eyes fall into shadow under the brow; everything outside the pool is near black.
COLOUR: photochemical film look: fine grain, deep true blacks with detail, natural skin and material colours, restrained saturation.
MOMENT: a sharp frame with a little natural motion blur on the fastest limb only.
LOOK: the light comes from straight above, so the eyes sink into shadow; warm amber tones, underexposed, most of the room black; the camera at eye height, almost still.
FACES: turned away from the lens, in profile, three-quarter or from behind.
AVOID: not a centred front-facing subject; the subject is off-centre, seen in profile, three-quarter or from behind; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; matte worn floor, no glossy or wet reflections; worn real textures with dust, creases and small defects, nothing plastic or perfectly clean; no over-saturated HDR look; restrained colour and true blacks.
One frame only: no collage, no split screen, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no border.
